desc:
The world is ending... but Corporate only cares about PROFITS! 

📉 Grab your shovel, head underground, and dig up the oldest treasures before it all blows up!Civilization is on the brink. We need to save what's left of humanity! Your job? Dig deep, uncover ancient remnants, and fulfill your destiny by finding the Artifacts in the abyss.

How to Play: 
⛏️ DIG: Smash the terrain and uncover buried "Ancient" relics! 
💰 SELL: Exchange your trash... uh, I mean "Relics" for cash at the Drop Pod! 
🛠️ UPGRADE: Talk to your partners at Camp to buy better tools and gear! 
🏃 ESCAPE: The world is collapsing—get out alive with the [Artifacts]!
✨ Explore: 5 completely unique geological layers!

🤝 Co-op: Squad up with friends in a 4-player team for double the efficiency!
